How Dr. Ehsan can help

Four areas of training and practice, one approach: explain everything, and decide together.

Cancer care

Diagnosis, treatment plans, immunotherapy and chemotherapy, and life after treatment.

Blood disorders

Anemia, clotting problems, leukemia, lymphoma, myeloma and abnormal blood counts.

Internal medicine

Whole-person care, including blood pressure, diabetes and the health problems that come with cancer.

Palliative & hospice care

Relief from pain and symptoms at any stage, and support for families when it matters most.

Telemedicine from Texas

Dr. Ehsan sees patients by secure video and is not at the California offices that week. Your clinic sends the link and tells you whether to join from home or from an office.

To book, confirm, cancel or change a visit, call your clinic. This website and Dr. Ehsan’s social media can’t schedule appointments and aren’t monitored for medical questions. Please don’t send personal health information here.

Medical emergency? Call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room.

About Dr. Ehsan

Dr. Alex Ehsan is a medical oncologist, hematologist and internist who cares for adults with cancer and blood disorders across Los Angeles, and supports patients and families through palliative and hospice care.

He started this free website because patients kept asking the same good questions — and deserved clear, written answers they could take home and share.

Board certified, Medical OncologyBoard certified, Internal MedicineTop Doctor in TexasPatient’s Choice AwardSpeaks English, Spanish and Farsi

  4. North TexasMedical oncologist; Chief of Medicine at Texoma Medical Center; Adjunct Clinical Assistant Professor, UNT Health Science Center at Fort Worth
  5. Los AngelesStarling Oncology, Downey and Culver City
